waitlist.join.statement: INSERT INTO waitlist (email, source, joined_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING

notify.subject: New on the waitlist from {input.source}
notify.body:
{input.email} joined the waitlist.
They came from {input.source}.

orders.place.statement: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, print_id, placed_at) SELECT ?1, id, ?3 FROM prints WHERE id = ?2 AND stock > (SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE print_id = ?2)

notify.subject: Your order for {input.print}
notify.body:
We have your order for {input.print}.
Your account is {actor.id}.

prints.list.statement: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.stock - (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.print_id = p.id) AS left FROM prints p ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 50
